key.name: record
key.description: Turning this off leaves the archive readable but stops new entries being added. Nothing already archived is removed.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste immediately when an entry is chosen
key.description: Puts the entry on the clipboard and types the paste shortcut into the window that had the keyboard. With this off, the entry is only placed on the clipboard and pasting stays a deliberate act.

key.name: max-entry-megabytes
key.summary: Largest single representation to archive, in megabytes
key.description: A representation larger than this is skipped. The entry is still archived if any of its other representations fit.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.summary: Applications whose copies are never archived
key.description: Window class names, matched without regard to case. Password managers are already excluded whatever this says, because they mark their clipboard content as a secret.

key.name: terminal-apps
key.description: In a terminal Ctrl+V is the literal-next-character escape rather than paste. Leaving this empty uses a built-in list of the common terminals; setting it replaces that list.
